profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software engineer with extensive experience optimizing engineering teams to be more effective through dev tools. Experience with both legacy products and releasing new services, at Google scale and reliability expectations.  Proven track record of meeting goals using innovation and strategic problem-solving abilities while working with multiple stakeholders and across various teams to achieve the larger product goal.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Took on various short-term roles related to Developer Experience (DX) and Platform.
CI/CD Team
Added support for kubernetes multi-cluster/multi-region deployments to CI/CD.
Created e2e testing/prober framework for release validation.
Observability & Telemetry
Gave support and aided in the transition to standard pipe system for logs and metrics and pay down tech debt on observability systems.
Created Infrastructure-as-Code framework with plans to integrate with systems across the company.
Support for Legacy Tool
Helped update AWS integration for legacy orphaned tool used for resource provisioning and management including long-term operations (such as database migrations). Required identifying old code, recognizing new owners after company-wide re-org, and coordinating everyone to do migration.
Also built an AI tool that helped automate most of the cases for migration.
Workflows
Integrated with team, helping promote use of Temporal Cloud across the company.
Helped set up self-hosted Temporal service to guarantee flexibility between vendor vs self-hosted solutions.
Added support for those using client library to automatically migrate between both clusters automatically in a transparent way to the customer.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Multiple roles @ Google

Large focus on Developer Productivity and platforms. Focus on performance validation, testing and improving. Helping automate and improve release pipelines. Work on improving products in general and dealing with technical debt.

Worked on internal tool for automated performance testing for both microbenchmarks and large-scale system changes (CPU/Kernel/Compiler/etc.)

Worked with Google Appengine, helped with transition into Google Cloud Run, Functions and exposing services as new Cloud products.

Worked with Google Cloud Firestore working to ensure a succesful launch, working on problems of performance and scaling, as well as internal consistency.
